scripts.optimize:desk: npm run optimize:desk:full && npm run optimize:desk:light
scripts.optimize:desk:full: gltf-transform optimize model-sources/workstation.raw.glb public/assets/workstation.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 2048 --simplify false --join false --flatten false --instance false --palette false --prune-attributes false
scripts.optimize:desk:light: gltf-transform optimize model-sources/workstation.raw.glb public/assets/workstation-mobile.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --simplify false --join false --flatten false --instance false --palette false --prune-attributes false
